text: {"defects": ["The final 'Total' amount (US$199.50) has very low contrast (light grey text on a light grey background), making it hard to read and inconsistent with the other prices.", "The credit card input field is improperly formatted, with the 'Card number' placeholder flush against the left border and 'MM / YY' and 'CVC' floating in the middle of an overly tall box.", "The 'Total' column for 'Ceramic Coffee Mug' (X 2) shows the unit price (US$14.00) instead of the line total (US$28.00), causing the item prices not to visually add up to the US$199.50 sub-total."]}

defects: The final 'Total' amount (US$199.50) has very low contrast (light grey text on a light grey background), making it hard to read and inconsistent with the other prices.
The credit card input field is improperly formatted, with the 'Card number' placeholder flush against the left border and 'MM / YY' and 'CVC' floating in the middle of an overly tall box.
The 'Total' column for 'Ceramic Coffee Mug' (X 2) shows the unit price (US$14.00) instead of the line total (US$28.00), causing the item prices not to visually add up to the US$199.50 sub-total.
